customer: I've torn the house apart looking for the title to my convertible and it's nowhere, and I'm supposed to bring it in to sell to Northwind. I'm retired, not a detective, and this is driving me up the wall. What on earth am I supposed to do now?
agent: I'm sorry for the stress, but there's good news: Dunmore uses electronic titles, so for a sale to Northwind you usually don't need a paper copy at all, since we transfer the electronic title at your appointment. If you'd still like a printed duplicate for your records, you can request it online from the Dunmore motor vehicle agency, and it arrives in 5 to 7 business days. You can read more in our article "Getting a duplicate title in Dunmore."
